decisions.reason: GA4 is now the mandatory Google Analytics standard, so the plugin meets client demand and fits the firm's analytics-focused service bundle at low upkeep cost.
Google shut down Universal Analytics in 2023/2024, so the plugin falls far below any aspiration and maintaining it wastes developer capacity better shifted to GA4 and other projects.
Interface plugins to retail systems draw on the firm's core integration skills and support shop projects, so carrying it costs little while its results mature.
Relaunch SEO support has its own page, fits the firm's core relaunch business, is a labor-based service with little fixed cost, and complements other offerings.
